title: Benchmarking Bilevel Derivative-Free Optimization Algorithms
summary: Bilevel optimization involves an upper-level and a lower-level decision maker. The lower-level optimization problem is nested within the constraints of the upper-level one. A point is said to be admissible for the bilevel problem if it satisfies all constraints and is optimal for the lower-level decision-maker. Bilevel derivative-free optimization (BL-DFO) algorithms address bilevel optimization problems in which the upper-level is solved using a derivative-free optimization method, and an inexact method it used to solve the lower- level.
